description: Retrospective planning application for a 1.5m (depth) rear extension together with a retractable pegola/canopy at the rear to create a ground floor terrace, an air condition unit and the repositioning of the existing external duct to a new location.
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Any new / existing plant shall be installed, together with any associated ancillary equipment, so as to prevent the transmission of noise and vibration into neighbouring premises.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">The rated noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not increase the existing background noise level (10dB below) when measured 1m external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises. An assessment of the expected noise levels shall be carried out by a suitably qualified (IOA accredited) and experienced acoustic consultant, in accordance with BS 4142:2014+A1:2019 ‘Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound,’ and any mitigation measures necessary to achieve the above required noise levels shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval within 3 months of the date of this permission. The plant shall thereafter be installed and maintained in accordance with the approved details.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-73afc0f2-7fff-5454-0b4e-c9569db9dc65"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: </span><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">To protect acceptable local noise levels</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Details of the cleaning and maintenance plan shall be submitted to and approved in writing to the Local Planning Authority within 3 months of the date of this permission. Details shall include odour control, extraction system maintained and cleaned every 3 months, ducting maintained and cleaned every six months unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority and maintained in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span id="docs-internal-guid-9534d980-7fff-2ba4-2d3f-555ebe0b0621"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;text-align: justify;margin-top:6pt;margin-bottom:6pt;"><span style="font-size:10pt;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;color:#000000;background-color:transparent;font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;white-space:pre;white-space:pre-wrap;">Reason: In order to safeguard the amenity of neighbouring occupiers in terms of the smells/odours from cooking.</span></p>
